title: Alcohol use disorder: severity and remission
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM code for the patient's alcohol use, if any is reportable.
note:
Chief Complaint: Follow-up for alcohol use history.

HPI: Pt is a 68-year-old female presenting for a scheduled follow-up. Pt reports she has not consumed any alcohol for over a year. She states she feels stable and is motivated to maintain her current lifestyle. She denies any recent cravings or physical discomfort. She is here to monitor her status and ensure continued stability. She reports good sleep and appetite.

Medication List:
- Multivitamin daily
- Vitamin B complex daily

Review of Systems:
General: No fatigue, no weight changes.
HEENT: No vision changes, no hearing loss.
Respiratory: No SOB, no cough.
CV: No chest pain, no palpitations.
GI: No abdominal pain, no nausea.
MSK: No joint pain.
Neuro: No tremors, no dizziness.

Social History: Pt is retired. Lives with her daughter. No tobacco use. No recreational drug use.

Family History: Mother had hypertension. Father had type 2 diabetes.

Vitals:
BP: 128/82
HR: 72 (RRR)
Temp: 98.6 F
SpO2: 98% on RA
Height: 5'4"
Weight: 155 lbs

Recent Labs:
HbA1c: 5.8%
TSH: 2.1 mIU/L
CMP: WNL
eGFR: >90

Exam:
Gen: Well-appearing, alert, and oriented x3.
CV: RRR, no murmurs, rubs, or gallops.
Lungs: CTAB.
Abdomen: Soft, non-tender, no organomegaly.
Neuro: Cranial nerves intact, gait steady, no tremors noted.

Assessment:
1. Alcohol use disorder, severe. Pt is currently in sustained remission. Pt has successfully abstained from alcohol for over a year. She shows good insight and remains stable at this time.

Plan:
1. Alcohol use disorder, severe: Continue current plan of abstinence. Encouraged pt to continue attending community support meetings.
2. Follow up in 3 months for routine monitoring.

Electronically signed, S. Patel, DO, 05/14/2026
explanations: Alcohol use disorder, moderate or severe, in remission: F10.21, alcohol dependence in remission (HCC 139).

distractors.why: Moderate or severe use disorder is dependence (F10.2-).

hccs.label: Alcohol Use Disorder/Moderate/Severe/Alcohol Use with Specified Non-Psychotic Complications
